description: List every city What's Up In covers, with its site, its own MCP endpoint, its status (live or beta) and how many travel-worthy events it indexes now. Call it to find valid `city` values for search_events, list_upcoming, get_event and get_city, or names for search_across_cities' `cities`; for one city's neighborhoods, topics and event counts use get_city. Takes no arguments; the list changes only when a city launches. No sign-in; each client gets 30 calls a minute and 2,500 event rows an hour.
name: list_cities
title: List cities
